plan.scope: Original ten issue packages reused for a predeclared development-rescue comparison; 30 fresh actor sessions, not fresh issues or confirmatory holdout. Repeated low is a contemporaneous control. One observation/task/arm; engineering overhead excluded. Fresh transfer, if prepared, must be separately frozen and reported.

safeguardEvents.command: git status --short && node .suffice-checks/probe.mjs && node .suffice-checks/preserve.mjs && npm run lint

mkdir -p .suffice-checks && cat > .suffice-checks/probe.mjs <<'EOF'
import fastqueue from '../queue.js'

const starts = []
const callbacks = []
const q = fastqueue((value, done) => { starts.push(value); callbacks.push(done) }, 1)
q.push(0)
q.push(1)
q.pause()
q.resume()
if (starts.length !== 1) throw new Error(`expected concurrency 1 after resume, got ${starts.length}`)
EOF
node .suffice-checks/probe.mjs; status=$?; echo probe_exit:$status; exit 0
node .suffice-checks/probe.mjs && node .suffice-checks/preserve.mjs && npm test && npm run typescript
